label: prop:positive-definite-dagger
title: Frobenius dagger is positive-definite
html:
Proposition. Frobenius dagger is positive-definite

A positive-definite dagger gives categorical states genuine squared lengths. Let (\mathbf{C}, A) be a quantum universe whose endomorphism ring \mathrm{End}(\mathbf{1}) \cong R is a formally-real ordered field. Assume a Frobenius pairing and a pivotal antipode S that is self-adjoint for the pairing.

Define the Frobenius dagger on morphisms by:

  f^{\dagger} =  \int_A \circ\, \mu(S(f) \otimes -).

The Frobenius dagger satisfies S^2 = \mathrm{id} and restricts to S = \dagger on \mathrm{End}(\mathbf{1}). The functor \dagger is a positive-definite involutive structure. For every non-zero morphism f \colon \mathbf{1} \to X, the composite f^{\dagger} \circ f is a positive element of R.
